regressionBeforeFix.method: Unmodified packaged UI actual play/pause button click; real IPC. Direct RPC play works; React event reaches command arguments and cannot be cloned.

validation.regression: Three PlayerBar and two TopBar event/structured-clone cases fail before their fixes and pass after.

build.kind: local unsigned macOS arm64 dir app
build.layout: Physical node_modules cloned into an isolated staging project; source out and build hooks copied from the feature.
build.initialSetupFailure: The first QA bundle from a worktree with symlinked node_modules omitted transitive dependencies (axios/debug) and could not boot. A physical-dependency rebuild boots; this was a QA layout issue, not a product packaging fix.

scope: Generated local silent WAV files; real preload/IPC and React DOM click handlers.
No source-module imports or temporary renderer entry in the packaged app.
Runtime exception monitoring covers attached UI/host during the exercised flow, not every startup moment.
No physical mouse/media keys, hardware device switch, Windows runtime, macOS x64, DMG installation, real account statistics, signed Apple playback or target-game performance acceptance.
Cold request evidence combines resource timing and Network observation; no private engine hasSource assertion.

developmentSmoke.method: Actual npm run dev app, isolated userData; local API seeds queue and actual PlayerBar DOM clicks control real playback host.
